description: An edit changes the ceiling, never the meter. Lowering a limit mid-window must never increase what can be spent.

requests.note: 8.4A - same limit id, same window spec, so the accumulator carries
80.00 already reserved against a 50.00 ceiling. Restarting the window here would have permitted 130.00 in a month capped first at 100 and then at 50.
October is a new window instance; the meter is new because the month is, not because the charter changed
